$comment: Canonical registry for MindAttic.Deploy. Two arrays: `sites` is verbatim root-site FTP uploads (mindattic.com root, mindatticcares.com, ryandebraal.com, plus the hyperspace and idiotproof-replays subfolders); `apps` is Blazor / GitHub-Actions-driven deploys (push-to-deploy; disabled entries print their note). Deploy = node src/deploy.js with a mode flag (--site/--sites/--uiux/--app/--apps); a bare run prints usage and exits 2. Asset versions are pinned per site by the linked deploy (below), not here. LINKED GROUPS (permanent): `linkedGroups` declares sets of sites that are inseparable from a shared package repo. Today `mindattic-web` = the MindAttic.UiUx jsDelivr asset package + ryandebraal.com + mindatticcares.com + mindattic.com. Deploying ANY member (`--site <slug>`, `--sites`, or `--uiux`) deploys the WHOLE group via src/linked.js: preflight (package repo clean, on main, not behind origin, manifest current) -> tag the package V<n+1> if HEAD is ahead of the latest tag and push main + the tag -> pin that tag in every site -> run the sites' preDeploy hooks (a hook with `tagArg` receives the tag) -> CDN gate (every asset the sites use must be live on jsDelivr at that tag, byte-exact) -> FTP the sites in the listed order (mindattic.com last: its sync hook runs there). `sites[]` order inside the group = FTP order. `--no-link` is the escape hatch for a one-site deploy. See docs/BIBLE.md (DEP-§4).
